items.q: How long before we start ranking in the local map pack?
items.a: Most clinics see grid-level movement within 30–45 days as GBP, citations, and reviews stabilize. Top-3 map-pack placement for competitive city + specialty terms typically lands between month 3 and month 6, depending on competitor density and review velocity.

items.q: Do you work with multi-location dermatology practices?
items.a: Yes — this is a core specialty. We build a scalable location architecture: one authoritative service page plus a unique landing page for every clinic address, each with its own GBP, schema, staff, hours, and reviews. This prevents cannibalization and lets you dominate 5–20 cities without duplicate content risk.

Yes. Reviews are collected via BAA-covered platforms, response templates never reference protected health information, and schema is scoped to business data only. We also audit any existing widgets or forms on your site for HIPAA exposure before we touch them.

items.q: Do you manage the Google reviews themselves?
items.a: We manage the flow — post-visit SMS/email review requests, response drafting, negative-review escalation protocol, and monthly reporting. Every response is human-reviewed before posting, and dermatologist sign-off is available on request.

items.q: What if I already have a Google Business Profile?
items.a: Perfect — we audit it first. In most cases we recover ranking by fixing categories, primary category selection, service list, Q&A hygiene, and post cadence — no rebuild required. If the profile is suspended or duplicated, we handle reinstatement and duplicate suppression as part of onboarding.

items.q: How is this different from generic local SEO?
items.a: Dermatology local SEO has to pass YMYL (Your Money or Your Life) scrutiny, MedicalBusiness schema requirements, and patient-review compliance rules. Generic agencies miss those and get pages deranked. Every playbook we run is written for medical practices from the ground up.
